messages.author: 267c7c6c510dc8a2
messages.subject: New Deducer Plug-in gMCP
parts:
Hi all,

There is a new package gMCP on CRAN that plugs into Deducer.

------------------------------------------
gMCP: A graphical approach to sequentially rejective multiple test procedures

This package provides functions and a graphical user interface for
graphical described sequentially rejective multiple test procedures
------------------------------------------

Though it is in its early stages of development, it looks like a very
promising and interesting package.

As it makes it's way through CRAN, it can be installed with:
install.packages("gMCP",type="source")

More information including a vignette is available on the cran package
page: http://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/gMCP/index.html

Ian

messages.author: 267c7c6c510dc8a2
messages.subject: Re: New Deducer Plug-in gMCP
parts:
The error log was not very informative. just an unrelated bookkeeping error.

First, make sure all your packages are up-to-date using: update.packages()

Then restart JGR.

Try the following.
1. open JGR with only the default packages (not Deducer).

2. Enter:
plot(1:10)

3. Try to save as png through the "Save as PNG" menu item

4. Enter the following:
.jgr.save.JavaGD.as(png,2,"sass.png",units="in",res=72)

5. in JGR and in the regular R gui enter:
png("png.png")
plot(1:10)
dev.off()

Were you able to save through the menu? do you see sass.png in your
working dir? what about png.png? Any crashes?

Then try the same thing with Deducer loaded.


Ian
